primitives.does: Determine the assurance level this context requires. Assurance is a property of what is being done rather than of who is doing it - setting it per user produces an over-challenged ordinary session and an under-challenged sensitive one at the same time

primitives.asks: Does the existing authentication already meet the required level?

branches.label: Sufficient
branches.test: a current session holds the required assurance and has not expired

branches.label: Not sufficient
branches.test: no session, an expired one, or one at a lower assurance than this context needs

primitives.state: already authenticated at the required level
primitives.reEntry: a context requiring higher assurance re-opens this. Being authenticated says who the actor is and nothing about what they may do

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: an asserted time bound lies inside the urgent horizon and permission for messages on this channel is recorded

primitives.reads: the the authentication session re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

primitives.state: challenge unanswered; nothing authenticated and nothing recorded against the actor
primitives.reEntry: a new attempt issues a new challenge

branches.label: Authenticated at the required level
branches.test: the challenge succeeded at the assurance this context needs

branches.label: Authenticated below the required level
branches.test: control was established, at a lower assurance than the context requires

primitives.does: Issue or update the authenticated session with an explicit assurance level and an explicit validity. Both are needed downstream: without the level nothing can require a step-up, and without the validity nothing can decide the session has aged out

primitives.state: authenticated, at a stated assurance and for a stated validity
primitives.reEntry: authorization for any particular action is decided separately, every time - a successful login proves control of an account and entitlement to nothing

primitives.on: control established below the assurance the context requires
carries: the session and the assurance it currently holds
the explicit fact that one failure is a signal rather than a finding
